mapper.select:
select id, cid , api_code , short_name as shortName , applet_date as appletDate , user_type as userType , format(data_count,'N0') as dataCount , bmsr.applet_begin_time as appletBeginTime , bmsr.applet_end_time as appletEndTime , bmsr.create_time as createTime , bmsr.update_time as updateTime from b_marketing_transfer_sync_report bmsr
order by bmsr.applet_date desc,bmsr.create_time desc,bmsr.id desc

select sum(data_count) as numTotal,api_code from b_marketing_transfer_sync_report bmsr
group by api_code

where.if: and (bmsr.cid like concat("%", #{cidOrName},"%") or bmsr.short_name like concat("%", #{cidOrName},"%"))

mapper.select:
select
distinct
from b_marketing_transfer_sync_report
order by ${orderByClause}

SELECT r.api_code AS apiCode, r.data_count AS dataCount, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS snapTime FROM b_marketing_transfer_sync_report r WHERE
r.api_code IN
#{apiCode}
1 = 0
AND r.update_time >= TIMESTAMP(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '08:00:00') AND r.update_time < TIMESTAMP(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '08:01:00') AND r.id = ( SELECT r2.id FROM b_marketing_transfer_sync_report r2 WHERE r2.api_code = r.api_code AND r2.update_time >= TIMESTAMP(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '08:00:00') AND r2.update_time < TIMESTAMP(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '08:01:00') ORDER BY r2.update_time DESC, r2.id DESC LIMIT 1 )

SELECT r.api_code AS apiCode, r.data_count AS dataCount, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS snapTime FROM b_marketing_transfer_sync_report r WHERE
r.api_code IN
#{apiCode}
1 = 0
